title: Past-Due Window by Home-Site Lease Standing: Community Rules & Site Care Decision Table
content:
The charges held back as not yet past due on the Community Rules & Site Care statement follow the resident's standing on the Home-Site Lease.

| Standing on the Home-Site Lease | Charges held back as not yet past due |
|---|---|
| The lease is under a certified-funds-only restriction, or carries a site-rent balance owing | none: every charge on the statement counts as past due |
| Neither of those holds, and the resident has at least 120 months of tenure with at most one returned payment on the Home-Site Lease ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date | the charges dated within the 2 calendar months ending on the handling date |
| Otherwise | the charges dated within the 1 calendar month ending on the handling date |

Tenure is counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date. A site-rent balance owing is a rent balance above zero on the lease.

## Points of judgement

- The first row governs whenever the restriction or a rent balance owing is present, whatever the tenure or the returned payments.
- 119 months of tenure with no returned payment falls under the last row; 120 months with one returned payment falls under the middle row; 120 months with two returned payments falls under the last row.

## Hypothetical case

Charges dated 20 August ($40.00), 20 September ($85.00) and 1 October ($59.00), handling date 9 October:

| Row | Charges held back |
|---|---|
| Restriction or rent balance owing | none |
| Middle row | all three, $184.00 |
| Last row | 20 September and 1 October, $144.00 |
